digest.component_or_area: code-review batch runner and gate dispatch
propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion id, preventing activated project criteria from being executed and attributed in Round A/B

Project criteria are not injected into code-review YAML; they must be read dynamically at gate dispatch time from registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing, then resolved to physical prompts via criterion_prompt_id
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only (not Round B) and never consume the Round-B escalation cap, requiring explicit branching on step_id in the runner
Finding attribution must preserve model-emitted criteria tags and append logical criterion_id once per project entry, maintaining physical reviewer_id provenance
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts must fail loudly with a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path, without silently degrading to built-ins
